_comment: Forge materials (issue #112), kept in the town stores (Empire.progress.armory.mats, scripts/armory.gd). Every material has a use (data/forge.json; tests/test_items.gd checks it) and a source. region: where it belongs (data/provinces.json regions); tier: the gear tier it is for. value: Gilt the Market pays for one (it sells for double). enemies: per-kill drop for a kind from data/enemies.json: chance, then a weighted table (one material, 1 to 'most' of it). regions: per-kill drop on any mission in a province of that region when the kind has no table of its own, so a chapter's new enemies drop its materials without more data here. Raid caches and Salvage piles hold materials too (data/mission_types.json, cache and pile).

blank_pith.name: Blank Pith
blank_pith.blurb: What's left when the Blank stops chewing: a white, weightless fluff that makes your teeth itch. The Forge quenches blades in it so they bite things that aren't there.

scrap_iron.name: Scrap Iron
scrap_iron.blurb: Bent shield rims, broken pike heads, the odd Concord buckle. The smiths don't ask where it came from, and you don't tell them.

moth_silk.name: Moth Silk
moth_silk.blurb: Spun from the wings of letter-moths. Faint words still run along the thread if you hold it to a candle.

oak_gall.name: Oak Gall
oak_gall.blurb: The ink-maker's oldest friend: a wasp's nursery, ground to powder. Bitter, black and good for what ails you.

tithe_wax.name: Tithe Wax
tithe_wax.blurb: Red sealing wax scraped off Concord strongboxes. It still smells of somebody else's money.

lamp_brass.name: Lamp Brass
lamp_brass.blurb: Fittings off Wickham's lamps: hinges, chimneys, little brass flames. Wickham would like them back.

relic_silver.name: Reliquary Silver
relic_silver.blurb: Prised off saints' boxes in the Abbey. The saints were not using it, and the Blank hates the shine.

bell_bronze.name: Bell Bronze
bell_bronze.blurb: Shards of a cracked abbey bell. Still hums when struck, and the humming makes erased things flinch.

ink_pearl.name: Ink Pearl
ink_pearl.blurb: Black pearls dived from the ink lake under the Causeway. Each one is a word the lake has not finished saying.

velvet_cord.name: Velvet Cord
velvet_cord.blurb: Rope from the masquerade's curtains, stronger than it looks. So is everyone at the masquerade.

saltglass.name: Saltglass
saltglass.blurb: Sea-water the Blank froze mid-wave. Clear, cold, and it remembers the shape of everything it touched.

wreck_oak.name: Wreck Oak
wreck_oak.blurb: Ship timbers that sailed into the white and washed back without their crews. Dense as stone and twice as stubborn.

spire_leaf.name: Spire Gold Leaf
spire_leaf.blurb: Gold beaten thin enough to see through, peeled off the capital's walls. The Concord gilds what it can't fix.

ledger_steel.name: Ledger Steel
ledger_steel.blurb: The bindings of the Great Ledger's own shelves. Folded a thousand times, like a lie told often enough.
